run_slurm_pipeline: run a SlurmPipelineExecutor to orchestrate a distributed data processing pipeline on a Slurm cluster
create_parquet_reader: create a ParquetReader that reads parquet files from a HuggingFace dataset with metadata and id key configuration
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that writes processed data to compressed jsonl files with configurable chunk sizes
build_data_pipeline: build a data pipeline using ParquetReader and JsonlWriter to convert parquet datasets to jsonl format
configure_slurm_executor: configure a SlurmPipelineExecutor with task count, resource limits, partition, and logging directory settings
